name: Ride to Happiness by Tomorrowland
description: Voted Best Roller Coaster in Europe in 2025 and 5th worldwide. A Mack Rides Xtreme Spinning Coaster with two magnetic launches, multiple inversions and free-spinning cars delivering sensations found nowhere else on earth.

name: Anubis The Ride
description: A powerful Gerstlauer Eurofighter launching riders from 0 to 90 km/h in just 2 seconds through a Top Hat, Dive Loop, Barrel Roll and intense airtime moments in an Egyptian themed setting.

name: Heidi The Ride
description: A compact and smooth GCI wooden roller coaster themed to the beloved Heidi character with fast pacing, quick twists and dips through beautiful park landscaping.

name: SuperSplash
description: A unique Mack Rides water coaster themed to Piet Piraat featuring a rotating vertical elevator lift followed by a thrilling drop into the central lagoon with spectacular views of the park.

name: Mega Mindy Ride
description: A thrilling family dark ride adventure starring the beloved superhero Mega Mindy, packed with special effects, surprises and exciting moments for families and children.

name: De Grote Golf
description: A spectacular Zamperla Disk'O ride themed to The Big Wave, swinging and spinning riders high into the air in a sweeping arc for thrilling family fun.

name: Storm at Sea
description: A classic swinging ship ride themed to a dramatic sea storm, rocking riders back and forth in a thrilling nautical adventure suitable for families and thrill seekers.

name: Wickie's Wervelwind
description: A fun spinning family ride themed to Wickie the Viking, sending riders whirling through a colourful adventure in the Wickie-themed area of the park.

name: Wickie de Viking
description: An exciting water battle ride set in the Wickie the Viking themed area where riders aboard Viking ships can soak each other and bystanders with powerful water cannons.

name: K3 Roller Skater
description: A Vekoma family roller coaster themed to the popular K3 pop group, delivering fun twists and turns at family-friendly speeds through a colourful musical setting.

name: Dino Splash
description: A thrilling log flume adventure through a prehistoric dinosaur world with exciting water effects and a soaking final drop surrounded by life-sized dinosaur figures.

name: Het Bos van Plop
description: An enchanting dark ride through the magical forest of Kabouter Plop filled with hundreds of charming animatronic gnomes and delightful surprises for young visitors.

name: Plop Tower
description: A gentle drop tower themed to Kabouter Plop lifting families high for panoramic views over the park before a soft descent, perfect for younger thrill seekers.
